text:
deploy-bot: HOLD initiated — ap-southeast ingress 5xx surge detected, canaries paused. All release windows frozen. Reason: ingress_5xx_rate > 4% for 5m :warning:
eng-release-lead-anna: noted. quick check: which part of the pipeline in this release could amplify an LB issue?
sre-kim: looks like request fanout increased error amplification at the api-proxy layer. the change in this deploy is a client-side routing tweak + a tiny nullable migration. routing tweak could increase parallel calls but not likely to cause 5xx by itself.
pm-olivia: release contents: routing optimization, client telemetry rename, and ADD COLUMN audit_id (nullable). migration is low-risk but still a schema change.
carla: migration behind flag cfn.feature.audit_id. we can keep the code and just disable the migration bootstrap path.
ops-raj: two options: 1) rollback full canary -> safe, pin prod; 2) flip migration flag and keep client-only changes in a small canary if SRE is comfortable. I prefer option 2 to avoid full rollback if safe.
sre-kim: i'd prefer to remove schema risk and test client change in isolation. if we keep any canary, cap it at 2% and watch latency+5xx.
eng-release-lead-anna: plan suggestion: immediately disable migration bootstrap, pin prod to v3.2.0, scale canary down to 2% and hold. If infra stabilizes (ingress_5xx <1% for 20m) we can resume normal rollout. If not, full rollback.
deploy-bot: ACTIONS queued:
- ops-raj: flip cfn.feature.audit_id -> OFF and redeploy canary config
- ops-raj: pin prod -> v3.2.0 (no code rollback unless needed)
- sre-kim: monitor ingress_5xx and request-fanout metrics, post 20m check
- pm-olivia: draft brief for support and update change-window to new slot
- carla: verify migration code path disabled in latest image
ops-raj: applying flag change now:
```bash
infractl feature-set --stack=prod --feature=cfn.feature.audit_id --value=false --reason="ingress-5xx-hold-6234567890"
kubectl rollout restart deployment/canary-router -n canary
```
ops-raj: flag flipped and canary config restarted at 6234568005. canary traffic throttled to 2%. pinning prod to v3.2.0 now:
```bash
deployctl pin --env=prod --version=v3.2.0 --reason="ingress-hold-6234567890"
```
ops-raj: pin complete at 6234568060. no rollback performed. :white_check_mark:
sre-kim: monitoring: ingress_5xx dropping from 5.2% -> 2.8% now, request-fanout still high but trending down. will post 20m status.
pm-olivia: updating support note and change window — tentatively moving migration to next maintenance slot (tomorrow 03:30 UTC). support ping in #customer-support sent.
carla: checked image: migration bootstrap disabled (env var present). ready to re-enable when safe.
deploy-bot: HOLD status updated: feature-flag-off + prod pinned + canary throttled at 2%. reference 6234567890. periodic updates every 10m.
eng-release-lead-anna: good containment. if ingress_5xx <1% sustained 20m, we do a controlled ramp: 2% -> 10% -> 50% with quick QA at each step. if any regression, immediate rollback. keep thread short and only post critical updates.
sre-kim: 10m update: ingress_5xx=1.9% and decreasing. will report at 20m mark (6234569090).
ops-raj: noted. standing by to either resume ramp or execute rollback (estimate rollback time 12m).
eng-release-lead-anna: thanks team. follow-ups: pm-olivia will finalize change-window, ops will keep pin until we signal resume.
